newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 182-day BBCs at 2.33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 182-day BBCs at 2.33 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 2.264 billion reais of 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight call money rate of 2.33 percent a month, dealers said.
The rate at the bank's weekly formal bond auction was up from 2.235 percent at last week's sale, and it was in line with morning market expectations.
The auction result show that 236 million reais will be added to the banking system as 2.5 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
